description: Score-honest wrapper around the fx2-cmix engine (Oct-2024 Hutter Prize winner): cmix-class context-mixing predictor with a single-pass Wikipedia transform, online reverse-dictionary transform, and paq8px-style NLP stemming. The cmix binary and english.dic dictionary are vendored in this directory and counted toward program_size.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary; rebuild from external/fx2-cmix/src for a portable submission
notes: small-scope ratios are dominated by dictionary pretraining cost; the ~11% asymptote only shows at full 1GB scale. 1GB run is on the order of tens of hours and tens of GB RAM.
